nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Where failure alerts go. Set alert_email and from_email to your address.

parameters.query:
-- Keep failed runs in the same audit log as everything else.
INSERT INTO lead_log (event, reason, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
SELECT event, reason, details, workflow_name, execution_id
FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::lead_log, $1::jsonb)
RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## 03 - Error Handler
Runs whenever 01 or 02 fails (set in their workflow settings). Sends the failed step, error and a link to the execution to Slack **and** email, so an alert still arrives if Slack is the thing that broke. Each alert step continues on error.
